title: L’Oréal Paris appoints Adria Arjona Global Ambassador as it enters ‘vibrant new chapter’
summary: The French beauty brand has appointed Adria Arjona Global Ambassador to show what its famous ‘I'm Worth It’ slogan means in 2026, with the Puerto Rican actress starring in a new L’Oréal Paris campaign that celebrates cultural connection and community pride
